programme.desc: Di bawah bayang eksploitasi kolonial Inggeris yang mencekik bumi Malaya di era 30-an, misi Nong Sani menghantar banduan wanita misteri (Melati) ke Mahkamah Negeri Selat terbantut apabila cuaca buruk memenjarakan mereka di sebuah rumah pemburu terpencil, bersama-sama Inspektor Lela dan dua lagi pemburu yang menjadi tuan rumah tersebut. Di sinilah Wadi, sang dalang dari gerakan "Nyalarong", menggunakan kelicikan penyamaran sebagai medan tempur halimunan demi menyelamatkan Melati, yang merupakan rakannya. Namun, apabila kesemua yang terperangkap mula dihujani syak wasangka, garis antara kesetiaan dan pengkhianatan menjadi kabur di bawah bumbung rumah usang tersebut. Kini, dalam ruang sempit tempat undang-undang kolonial telah lumpuh, mereka mesti mempertaruhkan segalanya dalam satu penentuan terakhir, di mana satu langkah sumbang tidak akan dibayar dengan sorakan, tetapi dengan nyawa. programme.title: Mithra
programme.desc: Sumalatha dan keluarganya bertungkus-lumus mencari jalan penyelesaian untuk mendapatkan duit sebanyak lima juta ringgit. Sumalatha terpaksa meredah pelbagai cabaran untuk mendapatkan jumlah duit tersebut. Isteri dan adik ipar Jayakumar berjaya melarikan diri daripada cengkaman samseng.

Akibat satu insiden, suaminya hilang dan tidak dapat dikesan dan ramai percaya bahawa dia telah meninggal dunia. Isterinya tidak dapat menerima berita tersebut sebaliknya yakin yang suaminya masih hidup. Dia terus menghantar emel kepada suaminya sehingga dituduh tidak siuman dan dimasukkan ke hospital sakit jiwa.

programme.title: Ustaz Adik Cik
programme.desc: Elisa yang perlu menjaga dua anak saudaranya, Arif, 16 thn, dan Afik, 8 thn, ketika ibu bapa mereka pergi ke Mekah untuk tunaikan haji. Elisa yang selama ini berlagak baik di hadapan keluarga tapi sebenarnya seorang yang gemar bersosial, terpaksa menyesuaikan diri ketika menjaga Arif dan Afik. Sikap Arif yang suka bermain dan malas belajar, membuatkan Arif lebih rapat dan suka pada Elisa. Kerana tidak tahan melihat kemungkaran yang berlaku dalam rumah, Afik keluar untuk tenangkan jiwanya di masjid. Tetapi ketika itulah dia diculik oleh sekumpulan penjenayah dan ini membuat Arif dan Elisa rasa amat bersalah.

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Dalam tempoh yang semakin singkat, Anggara berusaha mempertahankan cinta mereka sambil menemani Aini menghadapi detik-detik paling sukar dalam hidupnya. Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

programme.title: Deko Bajet
programme.desc: Untuk episod ini, pereka bentuk dalaman, Janna Baha selaku pengacara juga akan menghias semula bilik anak milik pasangan Ummar dan Atikah di sebuah kondominium di Bukit Jalil dengan Bajet Rm 3,000.00

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Ayam Cendawan Berkrim & Popia Vietnam In3 Udang sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Aifique Khaikal.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Hans menukar penampilan setelah dipaksa oleh Imran. Marlia dan Ira begitu terperanjat melihat penampilan Hans yang begitu kacak sekali. Ira dah mula rasa cemburu apabila Hans memuji Farah, salah seorang pekerja di syarikat mereka. Ira yang telah boleh berjalan terus sahaja meminta supaya dia mula kembali bekerja. Ketika membelibelah baju baru untuk ke pejabat bersama Hans, tiba-tiba Reez muncul di depan Ira. Reez minta diberi peluang kedua tetapi Ira telah lama membenci Reez. Ira terus pergi meninggalkan Reez. Ira mula merasaan dia selamat dan gembira bila bersama Hans. Walaupun bicara Ira terhadap Hans tetap kasar tetapi nadanya sudah berbeza dari dulu. Marlia perasan akan perubahan pada Ira. Marlia minta Ira tunaikan janjinya untuk berpisah dengan Hans. Ira mengadu kepada Imran dan memberitahu yang dia tidak sanggup berpisah dengan lelaki yang baik seperti Hans.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik keliru dengan perasaannya kerana sering terbayangkan Ana lalu mengadu kepada Dato' Ishmael tanpa pengetahuan Johan. Johan pula mengadu kepada Nani yang dia syak Ana sukakan Taufik. Ana cuba yakinkan Johan yang dia betul suka terhadapnya, bukan Taufik walaupun dia sendiri mula meragui perasaannya. Edora juga semakin rasa tercabar dengan Ana dan sering resah gelisah.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Usop cuba dapatkan wok dengan mencari deris. Namun siapa diri deris sudah mulai terbongkar. Dia tidak endah permintaan usop mengenai pemergiaan maimun. Betapa kejamnya deris, tidak langsung membawa wok balik untuk melihat arwah maimun untuk kali terakhir. Wok disiksa teruk dan tekad cuba membunuh deris.

programme.title: Misteri Mona
programme.desc: Anom mendakwa mendengar suara Mona dari loteng. Rasa curiga Farah terhadap Dr. Nadeem semakin memuncak apabila dia menyedari perwatakan dan nasihat 'doktor' itu tidak meyakinkan.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Kemarahan Ameena semakin memuncak manakala Zarif bergelut untuk mendapatkan semula kepercayaannya. Kesetiaan Harris yang tenang memaksa Ameena untuk mempersoalkan apa sebenarnya erti cinta dan pengabdian. Sementara itu, keputusasaan Maria membawanya ke jalan yang lebih gelap

Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn (Abdullah) menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Demi ibunya, Rizrin berhijrah ke KL selepas melepaskan kekasihnya, Ariyana, kepada abangnya. Di sana, dia bekerja dengan Vee, rakan kepada Dara yang baru memutuskan hubungan dengan kekasihnya yang curang, Ryan. Sementara itu, Ariyana gagal melupakan Rizrin dan melarikan diri daripada abang Rizrin.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana akur berkahwin dengan Azz walaupun masih menyayangi Rizrin. Bagi menyelamatkan keadaan, Rizrin mendesak ibunya mencari calon isteri lain. Sementara itu, pinangan Ryan terhadap Dara dibatalkan akibat keburukannya. Akhirnya, keluarga menetapkan perkahwinan antara Rizrin dan Dara, namun Ryan nekad mahu menghalangnya.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana cuba memujuk Izz kembali, tetapi ditolak demi kebahagiaan Azz. Ryan pula mengancam mahu memusnahkan sesiapa sahaja yang mengahwini Dara, malah cuba merogol Manja sebelum dihalang Eunos. Sementara itu, Izz dan Dara bakal dikahwinkan tanpa sedar mereka sebenarnya merupakan rakan karib di media sosial.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Kereta pancit Dara mempertemukan dirinya dan Izz di jalanan, mencetuskan pertengkaran. Walau bagaimanapun, mereka gembira meluahkan perihal jodoh masing-masing di e-mel sebagai "Cik Kak" dan "En. Beat". Rahsia itu hanya terbongkar pada hari pernikahan, mengejutkan kedua-duanya selepas mereka sah bergelar suami isteri.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Usop cuba dapatkan wok dengan mencari deris. Namun siapa diri deris sudah mulai terbongkar. Dia tidak endah permintaan usop mengenai pemergiaan maimun. Betapa kejamnya deris, tidak langsung membawa wok balik untuk melihat arwah maimun untuk kali terakhir. Wok disiksa teruk dan tekad cuba membunuh deris.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok terus didera, diikat. Sesekali dilayan, selalu lebih kepada hamba abdi. Deris semakin lupa daratan. Usop masih belum dapat mencari wok. Deris mula mendapat selera baru. Cuba menlanggani wani, budak baru berjinak-jinak menjadi call girl. Paling sedih, wani adalah adik Alai.

programme.title: Geng Daddy Daddy
programme.desc: Hafiz dan isterinya Melissa apabila ibu bapa Melissa secara mengejut datang ke rumah dan tinggal bersama-sama untuk beberapa hari. Pelbagai perkara lucu berlaku dan cuba di atasi oleh Hafiz yang selama ini mengharapkan isterinya melakukannya saperti memasak, menyembelih ayam dan membasuh baju.

programme.title: Secret Book Club
programme.desc: Keberanian Shasha membela Hidayah mendapat tentangan hebat daripada Pengetua dan Tuan Mustafa. Sementara Tini terus menjadi mangsa dera bapa saudaranya, Shasha nekad menubuhkan kelab buku biarpun disabotaj. Tini, Maya, dan Hidayah akhirnya menyertai kelab tersebut, tanpa menyedari mereka sedang diperhatikan oleh Ustazah Harissa.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Kemarahan Ameena semakin memuncak manakala Zarif bergelut untuk mendapatkan semula kepercayaannya. Kesetiaan Harris yang tenang memaksa Ameena untuk mempersoalkan apa sebenarnya erti cinta dan pengabdian. Sementara itu, keputusasaan Maria membawanya ke jalan yang lebih gelap

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Zarif dan Maria meneruskan hubungan gelap mereka, tanpa menyedari Ameena memerhati. Zaidi menggesa Ameena pulang ke rumah, Ameena meminta bantuan daripada orang yang tidak dijangka dan merancang langkah seterusnya

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Izz dan Dara pengsan di pelamin selepas mengetahui identiti masing-masing. Mereka cuba menerima takdir dan tinggal berhampiran rumah Ryan. Dendam Ryan mencetuskan pakatan fitnah sehingga Dara ditangkap polis atas tuduhan pecah masuk. Sementara itu, Ariyana memulangkan cincin pertunangan kepada Azz, manakala Nita mendapati dirinya hamil anak Ryan.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Hubungan Izz dan Dara mendingin akibat isu kejiranan Ryan, sebelum Dara akhirnya bersetuju berpindah demi masa depan mereka. Sementara itu, Ryan mendesak Nita menggugurkan kandungannya. Azz pula cuba memujuk Ariyana yang ingin memutuskan pertunangan mereka, manakala Eunos bertindak melindungi Manja daripada kekasihnya yang kaki pukul.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Izz dan Dara berpindah ke rumah baharu untuk menjauhi Ryan. Bagaimanapun, Ryan dengan licik sengaja meninggalkan telefonnya di butik Dara demi mencetuskan cemburu, menyebabkan Izz merajuk lalu menghilangkan diri. Sementara itu, Manja dipukul oleh Joe, dan Nita pula enggan menggugurkan kandungannya walaupun ditawarkan wang.

programme.desc: Wok akhirnya berjaya melarikan diri dari rumah Deris dengan bantuan Alai. Tempat yang paling selamat buat dirinya kini adalah di masjid atau surau. Sementara itu, Deris semakin teruja untuk mendapatkan Wani, namun dalam diam dia dibayangi rasa bersalah dan ketakutan terhadap balasan Tuhan. programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Dara yang keguguran menyalahkan Izz sehingga hubungan mereka retak, namun Vee berjaya memujuknya untuk berbaik semula. Sementara itu, Ryan terpaksa mengahwini Nita secara rahsia. Ariyana kemudian memfitnah dirinya sudah berkahwin dengan Izz.

programme.desc: Dara ke Melaka bertemu Ariyana yang akhirnya mengakui sudah melupakan Izz dan meminta Dara kembali kepada suaminya. Walau bagaimanapun, Azz enggan menerima Ariyana semula. Sementara itu, Ryan berang lalu memukul Nita selepas rahsia perkahwinan mereka terbongkar kepada Dara. Akhirnya, Izz kembali ke rumah selepas segalanya terurai.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ketika Izz dan Dara merancang bulan madu, Ryan menipu Dara dengan mendakwa dirinya menghidap tumor otak demi menagih simpati. Semasa mencari motornya, Epol bertembung dengan Azura yang beg tangannya turut diragut oleh kumpulan yang sama. Antaranya, menolak berjumpa dengan anaknya yang tinggal di asrama, membayar wang unutk ustaz mengajar mengaji anaknya dan apa jua aktiviti melibatkan kewangan.

programme.desc: Taufik dan Johan mengambil cuti kecemasan untuk menjemput bapa Taufik, Mustafa yang baru keluar dari penjara. Reez meminta Marlia membantunya merampas Ira dari Hans.

programme.title: INSPIRASI

programme.title: SEMBANG SELEBRITI

programme.title: TRENDSETTER

programme.title: KLTV 2026
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan informasi yang memfokuskan tentang dunia hiburan di Malaysia dari pelancaran music & wayang terbaru, isu isu panas terkini dan juga rancanga/Siri best untuk dilayan.

programme.title: KEMBARA

programme.title: RONDA RODA
programme.desc: Ronda Roda kali ini membawakan jiwa chopper sejati dalam Borak Motorkar bersama Sabri, disusuli segmen Review Kereta yang memaparkan kuasa Mercedes-Benz E53. Episod ini diakhiri di Gegar Garaj bersama Race & Rally yang memfokuskan kepada persediaan jentera lasak.

programme.title: 1001 RESEPI PERIUK NASI
programme.desc: Saksikan pelbagai cara menyediakan masak kegemaran semua dengan hanya mengunakan Periuk Nasi sahaja. Dalam episod ini Danny Aidil akan menyediakan 2 masakan, 1 pinggan iaitu Fettuccini Miso, Nasi Goreng Adobo & Paella Masak Lemak Cili Api.

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Zulin Aziz, Edaman Othman, Shazleen Shahbi dan Kimal Margasatwa.

programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Pengantara berada di Kg. Tanjung, Sabtu, Kuala Trengganu yang dikatakan mempunyai misteri tersendiri. Beliau bertemu dengan Encik Salleh Abdullah, beberapa istana lama yang dibina oleh Almarhum Tengku Ismail kerabat di raja Trengganu yang dijadikan pusat tenun kain songket orang kampung. Kononnya satu keluarga bunian masih berada di lokasi. Ossasuke Hikaru (OH) seorang aktivitis Paranormal berkongsi pengalaman yang pernah dilalui semasa menjalankan aktiviti di situ. Pengantara bersama OH dan krew kemudiannya berada di lokasi istana lama tersebut selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi seram dan menakutkan.

Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Brick Mansion

Di sekeliling kawasan itu terdapat tembok gergasi untuk memastikan seluruh Detroit selamat. Bagi polis yang menyamar Damien Collier, setiap hari adalah perjuangan menentang rasuah ketika dia berjuang untuk membawa pembunuh bapanya, Tremaine, ke muka pengadilan. Sementara itu, Damien dan bekas penipu bernama Lino bekerjasama untuk menyelamatkan bandar itu daripada komplot untuk memusnahkannya.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Rahsia

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

Fedi kini diuji untuk terus setia dan menjaga keluarganya dalam keadaan yang semakin mencabar.

programme.title: Buli

Filem ini mengangkat tema kepolosan, kasih sayang dan nostalgia zaman kanak-kanak.

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love

programme.title: Kembalinya Nenek Gayung

programme.desc: Fedi dan Kirana adalah pasangan bahagia yang hidup dengan rancangan masa depan yang indah. Oleh kerana terlalu obses, suatu hari Dadang nekad ke Jakarta menumpang lori demi bertemu idolanya. Namun, tanpa diduga dia bertemu Lilis yang diam-diam ikut ke Jakarta untuk melihat Monas. Kehadiran Lilis malah membuat usaha Dadang bertemu Janet jadi kacau.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Foodie Buddy
programme.desc: Program masakan dan kulinari yang meneroka keunikan serta kekayaan cita rasa hidangan Indonesia, menampilkan pelbagai sajian tradisional, ramuan tempatan dan pengalaman kulinari dari seluruh negara.

programme.title: Gaspol
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan permainan yang menghiburkan dengan pelbagai hadiah dan ganjaran wang tunai.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: D'Academy 7
programme.desc: D' Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai D'Academy musim ketujuh?

programme.title: Qari Cilik Season 3

programme.title: Idolanya Kaum Mendang Mending Jangan Ya Dek Ya!!

Oleh kerana terlalu obses, suatu hari Dadang nekad ke Jakarta menumpang lori demi bertemu idolanya. Namun, tanpa diduga dia bertemu Lilis yang diam-diam ikut ke Jakarta untuk melihat Monas. programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Seoul follow me! & What's On Today
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter

MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Our Theme Songs
programme.desc: TVB has created countless beloved classic dramas and pioneered a golden age of Cantonese drama theme songs. Each episode has a specific drama theme, guiding viewers into the world of television theme songs. It also invites the original singers of once-popular songs, along with other celebrity guests, to lend their voices. These classic songs have been re-arranged and given new life, allowing everyone to appreciate and experience the extraordinary charm of these drama hits!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: With AI becoming increasingly powerful, what happens if crucial details in a scene are subtly erased by it? Will everyone be able to retrieve the missing parts from memory, or will they all be left in a state of "brain fog"? Ruco Chan, along withJenny Ian and Felix Lam, co-host the quiz game show "Something's Missing", inviting two teams of celebrity artists each episode to battle wits and compete for a prize. In the show, AI acts as a "memory eraser," altering familiar dramas, classic music, landmark scenes, and more. Team members must use their memories to uncover the erased truth. After four rounds of intense brainpower, the team with the highest accumulated score will have the chance to win the Jackpot!

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Love On A Diet
programme.desc: Mini, heartbroken by the departure of her first love Kurokawa, transforms from a stunningly beautiful woman into an obese one. During her downfall, she meets a vengeful, fat knife seller named Fatty. Knowing Mini's past, Fatty helps her win back her lover. Mini successfully loses weight, leaving Kurokawa amazed. programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Threesome
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: With AI becoming increasingly powerful, what happens if crucial details in a scene are subtly erased by it? Will everyone be able to retrieve the missing parts from memory, or will they all be left in a state of "brain fog"? Ruco Chan, along withJenny Ian and Felix Lam, co-host the quiz game show "Something's Missing", inviting two teams of celebrity artists each episode to battle wits and compete for a prize. In the show, AI acts as a "memory eraser," altering familiar dramas, classic music, landmark scenes, and more. Team members must use their memories to uncover the erased truth. After four rounds of intense brainpower, the team with the highest accumulated score will have the chance to win the Jackpot!

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer (Zhong Chuxi) whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective; a judge (Francis Ng) who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge; and a charismatic legal elite (Zheng Yunlong) who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areas—these three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: "Following the trend" means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters' footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just "hype" to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a "real-life keyboard warrior," leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, "following the trend" can also have another meaning: following Rufeng's personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately "follow the trend"!

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.
